title: Борьба за место и отказ переезжать  (Fighting for His Place and Refusing to Move In)

segments.t: Welcome to Kukhnya Season 2, Episode 20. Max reflects on how he spent nearly a year earning his place in the kitchen and is ready to do anything to get it back. Meanwhile, at Elena's apartment, Chef Barinov stubbornly tries to fix a broken appliance himself and tells Elena he cannot move in with her.
Которого добивался почти год.
И готов на все, чтобы его вернуть.
Тимур, привет.
Что привез?
Кушать подано.
Что это?
Я мастера вызову.
Я сам справлюсь.
Тут просто контакта нет.
Я говорю, люди мы с тобой взрослые.
Эй, Витя.
Я не могу к тебе переехать.
Потому что я не могу к тебе переехать.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
Которого добивался почти год.
'Which I worked for almost a year to achieve.' Since which he worked for almost a year to achieve, Barinov does not waste words on excuses.
И готов на все, чтобы его вернуть.
'And I am ready to do anything to get it back.' Claiming that he is ready to do anything to get it back sounds confident, even if Barinov has doubts.
Тимур, привет.
'Timur, hey there.' With the moment and job in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Что привез?
'What did you bring today?' By asking what Barinov brings today, Timur presses Barinov for a straight answer.
Кушать подано.
'Breakfast is served.' Explaining that breakfast is served lays the cards on the table for Timur.
Что это?
'What on earth is that?' Timur asks whether what on earth is, refusing to let the point slide. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Я мастера вызову.
'I will call a repairman.' Claiming that he will call a repairman sounds confident, even if Timur has doubts.
Я сам справлюсь.
'I can handle it myself.' Pointing out that he can handle it himself gives Barinov a sobering reality check.
Тут просто контакта нет.
'There is simply a loose contact inside here.' Barinov explains that there is simply a loose contact inside here, keeping his voice calm and direct.
Я говорю, люди мы с тобой взрослые.
'I am saying, you and I are both grown adults.' Even though he is saying Barinov and he are both grown adults, Timur keeps a steady face in front of Barinov.
Эй, Витя.
'Hey, Vitya, watch out.' Saying that Timur should watch out is how Barinov sets the tone with Timur.
Я не могу к тебе переехать.

'I cannot move in with you.' Timur explains that he cannot move in with Barinov, keeping his voice calm and direct. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Потому что я не могу к тебе переехать.

'Because I simply cannot move in with you.' Admitting that because he simply cannot move in with Timur shows Barinov being honest for a change. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Которого добивался почти год.
И готов на все, чтобы его вернуть.
Тимур, привет.
Что привез?
Кушать подано.
Что это?
Я мастера вызову.
Я сам справлюсь.
Тут просто контакта нет.
Я говорю, люди мы с тобой взрослые.
Эй, Витя.
Я не могу к тебе переехать.
Потому что я не могу к тебе переехать.

That wraps up this scene as max vows to do anything to win back his job at Claude Monet, while at Elena's apartment Chef Barinov tries to fix an appliance and refuses to move in with her. Until next time!
Пока!
